'''Taval''', officially the '''Federal Republic of Taval''', is a country in [[Northern Massir]]. Located on the [[Passonin Island Chain]], it shares a land border with [[Ucrua]] on the mainland. The [[Diairesi Sea]] lies to the east of the mainland, the [[Eashor Sea]] to the west, and the [[Vihsanna Ocean]] to the northwest. Taval claims to have the [[List of countries by length of coastline|longest coastline]] on the continent, spanning [[Islands of Taval|thousands of islands]] from the savanna, mountains, and [[wikipedia:Rainforest|rainforest]]. It has a population of over [[List of countries and dependencies by population|44 million]]. [[Suraspa]] is the nation's capital and the third-largest city, behind [[Tamalpura]] and [[Chavindora]]. Taval is considered the [[cradle of civilization]] and the birthplace of [[wikipedia:Democracy|democracy]], modern philosophy, literature, historiography, [[wikipedia:Political_science|political science]], major scientific and mathematical principles, theatre, and the idea of international trade. The [[Ancient Alqirans]] were organized into various [[wikipedia:City-state|independent city-states]] and islands that spanned the [[Diairesi Sea]] and the [[Kera Sea]].

The first [[First Alqiran golden age|Alqiran golden period]] saw the height of [[Alqiran culture]] and influence in antiquity. The Alqirans city states in [[Ayuma]] (modern day [[Hkuqo]],) was annexed by [[Ealdorii Empire|Ealdorii]]. In 780 AFA, the second [[Second Alqiran golden era|Alqiran golden period]], the [[Evhalis Republic]], later the [[Alqir Empire]], where Alqiran culture and language were dominant. The [[Third Alqiran golden age|Third golden age]] started when Taval conquered the continent of [[New Ayre]] in the 14th century, and the [[wikipedia:Colonization|colonisation]] and exploitation that followed made the [[Alqiran island chain|Alqiran island]] the richest place in the world. Following the [[Tavalan Independence wars|independence wars]] by its colonies in the late 16th century, Taval began to decline as more land was ceded to other major powers. A [[First Tavalan republic|short-lived republic]] was established in 1663 but faced civil strife and the challenge of internal [[wikipedia:Refugee|refugees]] after a [[1663 Tavalan earthquake|major earthquake]] hit the island chain. In 1664, a royalist [[wikipedia:Dictatorship|dictatorship]] inaugurated a period of authoritarian rule, marked by [[wikipedia:Military_occupation|military occupation]], civil war, and military dictatorship. Taval transitioned to democracy in early 1684, leading to the current [[wikipedia:Parliamentary_republic|parliamentary republic]].

Having achieved [[wikipedia:Economic_growth|record economic growth]] from 1700 through the 1720s, Taval is a [[developed country]] with an advanced, [[List of countries by GDP (nominal) per capita|high-income economy]]. It was the tenth member to join what is today the [[Global Trade Union]] and is part of multiple international organisations and forums. Taval has a unique cultural heritage, a large [[wikipedia:Tourism#Tourism_industry|tourism industry]], and a prominent shipping sector. The country's rich historical legacy is reflected partly by its 37 [[Global Heritage Sites]]. Taval was the [[World Tourism rankings|tenth most-visited country]] in the world in 2024.
